name: todo_list
description:
Update the session's todo list. To be used proactively and often to track progress and pending tasks for non-trivial multi-step work.

Whole-list replacement — every call must send the COMPLETE new list; the old list is discarded. Only one item should be `in_progress` at a time; mark items `completed` as soon as they're done. Always provide both `content` (imperative, e.g. "Run tests") and `activeForm` (present-continuous, e.g. "Running tests") for every item.

After you call this the runtime will periodically (every ~10 LLM calls by default) re-inject the full list back into your context as a system reminder so you don't lose track. The list is surfaced on the HUD too.

Skip this tool for trivial one-step tasks, purely informational replies, or when you already have a concise mental model of the remaining work.

todos.description: The full new todo list. This REPLACES the previous list entirely — send all items, not a diff.
